verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents per-chat tool approval modes (docs-37) and Allow/Deny approval cards for pending agent actions (docs-13), plus RBAC roles that set baseline trust (docs-17, docs-47), so a permission-mode style of containment exists. However, the docs state that Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python on the server (docs-25), and nothing evidences container/VM isolation for tool runs. Air-gapping (docs-18) gives network isolation only at the deployment level. Missing for 10: documented container/VM sandboxing of tool or plugin execution, granular per-tool policies (filesystem/network scoping), independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval modes.
